summary: This April 22, 2025 Reason Becomes A Religion lecture is already public spine evidence for reason-as-replacement-religion, love restraining reason, and Rousseau's education fork; its impact is to close accounting for a source that recent synthesis depends on while keeping the mechanism routed through existing atlas and concept homes.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: replacing faith with reason, orthodoxy with debate, and truth with progress
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public episode read already links the opening substitution phrase to the atlas relation, and the public atlas page uses this source as the definition layer for modern reason inheriting religion's truth-making work.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: a new religion a state religion that is based on reason
existing_lens_links.rationale: This is the civil-religion intensification of the same atlas relation: reason is not merely a tool but a public sacred grammar for the revolutionary state.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Our ideas of religion become transplanted into the nation
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public read already links the nation-transfer mark to the atlas anchor, where religious loyalty moves into modern national sacrifice.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Dante said love is what God gave us; if you're capable of reasoning by yourself, you can reason anything
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Human Heart page already uses this source for the mechanism that love restrains solitary reason by forcing relation.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: let the child be a savage and not a peasant
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Education page already links Rousseau's savage/peasant contrast to rival formation, practical judgment, and resistance to school-as-control.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the dated origin layer for the atlas relation where modernity replaces faith, orthodoxy, and truth with reason, debate, and progress, then turns civil religion and nation into carriers of religious loyalty.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Reason As Replacement Religion owns sacred-work substitution as an atlas relation, not a standalone public page. Religion As Administrative Filter owns operator-selection codes; Nation owns sacrificial population machinery; Power owns symbol-to-reality conversion; Game Theory owns later false alternatives.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public as boundary prose: this lecture distinguishes replacement religion from administrative filter by showing reason, debate, progress, civil dogma, and nation taking over religion's truth and loyalty functions before asking who qualifies as a trusted operator.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Do not make Religion As Administrative Filter absorb the whole French Revolution source; use it only where doctrine, method, schooling, or office discipline selects trusted operators.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: preserve the Dante/Enlightenment contrast as Human Heart evidence that love restrains reason because love requires relation, while solitary reason can justify anything.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart owns relational restraint. Reason As Replacement Religion owns reason taking over sacred truth work; Dead World owns material-only ontology; Education owns practices that form or deform judgment.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep Rousseau's negative education, childhood, savage/peasant contrast, and school-as-control diagnosis as Education evidence for rival formation against premature abstraction and obedience training.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns formation through school, childhood, trust, control, and resilient judgment. Middle-Class Anxiety owns status proof only when anxiety and respectability are the active mechanism.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the nation-transfer passage for future Nation compression: revolutionary civil religion transplants home, family, tradition, food, and lived religious loyalty into national sacrifice.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Nation owns the collective body and sacrificial machinery after loyalty has moved into the state. The atlas relation owns the prior substitution of religious grammar by reason and civil dogma.

new_lens_seeds.title: Poet, Prophet, Prince As Revolutionary Crusade
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A revolutionary worldview needs a poet to imagine the promised land, a prophet to lead people toward it, and a prince to conquer outward from it.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The triad can route Rousseau, Robespierre, Napoleon, Marx, and other world-making sequences, but the current French Revolution arc can carry it inside Stories, Poetry, Legitimacy Fiction, and Reason As Replacement Religion without a standalone page.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create standalone Rousseau, Robespierre, Napoleon, Poet Prophet Prince, French Revolution, or Revolutionary Crusade pages from this source alone.

new_lens_seeds.title: Reason Without Love
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Reason becomes dangerous when it can operate alone, because without relation it can justify any system that appears internally coherent.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This is a strong reusable warning, but it is already publicly anchored inside Human Heart through heart-restrains-reason-through-love.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Keep as an existing Human Heart mechanism unless later sources prove a narrower child page is needed.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-04-22, this is the first lecture in Jiang's three-class French Revolution sequence and hands off to Robespierre and Napoleon.

This source predates the May 22 Marx/status-correction lecture and the December 16 modern-scapegoat lecture in the reason-as-replacement-religion cluster; later materialist false-salvation claims should be read as extensions of this substitution model, not as the origin.

The lecture also supplies an Education chronology layer: Rousseau's Emile is treated as the source of negative education, the modern concept of childhood, and the savage/peasant contrast before later school-critique sources intensify the mechanism.

canon_candidates.candidate: Modernity can inherit religion's truth-making and salvation functions while naming them reason, debate, progress, civil religion, nation, economics, science, or technocracy.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only. The June 19 materialist-false-salvation review kept this as an atlas relation and routing rule, not a standalone public page or promoted canon model.

canon_candidates.candidate: Love restrains reason because it requires another person; solitary reason can justify any internally coherent system, including destructive ones.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only. Public Human Heart already carries this as a lens point, so glossary/canon promotion should wait for a broader Human Heart review.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is needed: the source is already cited by the atlas relation, Religion As Administrative Filter, Human Heart, and Education, and the recent Materialist Religion review already adjudicated the public-page boundary.

If the French Revolution sequence is synthesized later, compare this Rousseau/reason source with the Robespierre and Napoleon lectures before creating any revolutionary-crusade, civil-religion, or poet-prophet-prince public surface.
If Nation gets a replacement/compression pass, use the religion-to-nation passage as an earlier support layer for nationalism inheriting home, tradition, and sacrificial loyalty.
